name: ChampHarbinger
description: Signal intelligence engine: discover companies, run buying-signal checks, enrich prospects, and pull qualified leads.

actions.label: Discover Companies
actions.description: Find companies matching an ICP description using semantic search.

icp.description: Ideal customer profile description (e.g. 'SaaS companies with 50-200 employees hiring VPs of Sales')

actions.label: Run Signal
actions.description: Check whether a buying signal has fired for a given company domain.

signal_id.description: UUID of the signal to run

actions.label: Enrich Company
actions.description: Pull product, funding, and team data for a company domain.

actions.label: Enrich Contact
actions.description: Enrich a person — infer email, find LinkedIn URL, score by seniority.

actions.label: Get Qualified Prospects
actions.description: Pull prospects that have cleared the handoff threshold in ChampHarbinger.

since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp — only return prospects qualified after this time

actions.label: List Signals
actions.description: Return all signals available in the connected ChampHarbinger workspace.
